dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the anterior-dorsal region exhibit high-intensity, light-colored perimeters with darker, lower-intensity internal centers. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary neck annulus and the two adjacent dorsal ring structures form a wide-angled scalene triangle oriented toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A sharp, high-contrast linear band of light pixels encircles the mid-body vertically, indicative of a circumferential entanglement scar or constriction mark.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct region of high-intensity saturation is present at the anterior-ventral margin where the neck meets the torso.
